column1: # Slovenian (sl) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Slovenian video-editing vocabulary (časovnica, sled, posnetek, sekvenca, mapa, predvajalna glava,
# oznaka, prehod, ključna sličica). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperatives ("Shrani kot …"),
# labels use sentence case, quotation marks are »…«, a space goes before the ellipsis, and product
# and format names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5).
# A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = posnetek, track = sled, sequence = sekvenca, timeline = časovnica, bin = mapa,
# playhead = predvajalna glava, marker = oznaka, label = nalepka, In/Out point = začetna/končna
# točka, keyframe = ključna sličica, frame = sličica, caption = podnapis, preset = prednastavitev,
# template = predloga, workspace = delovni prostor, gain = ojačitev, opacity = prekrivnost,
# render = upodabljanje, ripple = z zamikom, dissolve = pretapljanje, wipe = brisanje,
# voice-over = govor, proxy = posredniška datoteka, guide = vodilo, shortcut = bližnjica,
# media = predstavnost, (Legacy) = (staro).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see sl.tsv.attribution.
